column1: # ANSI-C ($'...') quotes are decoded exactly as bash does, so names and
# arguments resolve and every rule applies as if written plainly. Unsupported
# escapes stay literal (backslash + char) as in bash; a NUL ends the quoted
# value; \c before a backslash or the end and non-ASCII results are unresolved.
# $"..." (locale quote) is a plain double-quoted word. Format: see review.tsv.
